complete_examples.text: To estimate the vibration transmission of the dynamic interaction system, the power flow method is used.

Comparing the power flow of the TTBPCPSI and the TTBI systems at low frequencies, the maximum value of the power flow increases from 1e4 J/s to 1e6 J/s, and an increase in the low-frequency vibration of the train, track and bridge is also observed.
